{{Infobox |eng = Wine |source = [[Artisan Goods]] |buff = {{Name|Tipsy|link=Buffs#Tipsy{{!}}Tipsy}}{{Name|Speed|−1}} |buffduration = 30s |sellprice = 3 × Base [[Fruits|Fruit]] Price |ingredients = Any [[Fruits|Fruit]] (1) |craftingstation = {{Name|Keg}} |crafttime = 10,000m (≈7d) }} {{For|a detailed analysis of profit using the Keg|Keg Productivity}} {{For|a full list of wine prices|Fruits}} '''Wine''' is an [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made from the [[Keg]], taking 7 days. It can also be received as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]]. The sell price of Wine depends on the [[Fruits|fruit]] used (3 × Base Fruit Value). When consumed, wine causes a [[Buffs|Tipsy]] buff that decreases [[Speed]] by 1. The [[energy]] and [[health]] restored by Wine is equal to 1.75 × Base Fruit Value for edible fruit. For inedible fruit, Wine will restore energy equal to 25% Base Fruit Value and health equal to 11.25% Base Fruit Value. The color of the Wine also depends on the fruit used. '''Note:''' It is possible to acquire Wine that has no base fruit (from the [[Traveling Cart]] or a [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]], as a gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]], or a New Year's Eve gift from [[Leah]] or [[Elliott]]). This item is simply titled "Wine", has a selling price of {{Price|400}} (or {{Price|560}} with the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Artisan Profession]]), and restores 50 [[energy]] and 22 [[health]]. ==Aged Values== Wine can be placed inside a [[Cask]] to age from normal quality to silver, gold, and eventually iridium quality. Iridium quality doubles the base sell price of Wine. Wine takes the longest to age of any item in [[Cask]]s. It takes 2 seasons of aging to go from basic wine to iridium quality wine. Normal, silver, and gold quality Wine can be prematurely removed from a cask at any time by striking the cask with an [[Axes|Axe]], [[Hoes|Hoe]], or [[Pickaxes|Pickaxe]]. {| class="wikitable roundedborder" !Normal Quality !Silver Quality
